_comment: Fast batch-1 plain LoRA on the chunie v3 split (runs/k2-chunie-peft-v3-512/data/train.parquet, 20 deduped images) at 512px. Same adapter as the mass-LoRA chunie arms: rank 8, alpha 8, fp32 masters, adapters only, txtfusion.projector excluded (the bank skips it too). Plain engine: whole bf16 DiT on one GPU, no RamTorch Pipeline, no grad checkpointing, cache resident on the GPU, unmasked attention at batch 1.
_comment_speed: Measured at 512px batch 1 (krea2/tools/bench_fast_lora.py). Compiled: flash (PyTorch built-in) 0.333 s/step at 37 GiB, math 0.408 at 47.8 GiB (closest to fp32), cuDNN 0.798 (rebuilds its SDPA plan for every new caption length). Eager: flash 0.375, math 0.548, cuDNN 0.865. CUDA-graph modes segfault in Torch 2.10 Inductor (CPU kernel in the compiled backward).
_comment_schedule: 4000 batch-1 steps = the same 4000 samples as the old 1000 x batch-4 runs; warmup 20 like them, no cooldown.
_comment_tags: The loader reshuffles tags per visit; the cache stores 8 shuffled orderings per image and draws one per visit.
